mcq_fix.s: Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below the lists:  List-I (Satellite group) a. INSAT-3DS and Kalpana-1 b. Oceansat series c. RISAT, Cartosat, EMISAT and EOS-N1 d. GSAT-19, GSAT-29, GSAT-11 and GSAT-N2  List-II (Application domain) i. Broadband  ii. Weather monitoring  iii. Strategic surveillance  iv. Ocean studies

wrong topic: communication satellites / GSLV launches

patterns: APPSC tests remote-sensing basics: active sensor = laser, infrared sensors for volcanic heat, non-components/non-resolutions as traps ('minimisation', 'chemical').
Direct identification: first mapping satellite = Cartosat-1, geo-imaging = EOS-03, NISAR = NASA-ISRO, INFFRAS, MODIS full form.
Navigation-system owner match (Galileo = EU, GLONASS = Russia) recurs as 'incorrect pair'.
App adds many 2025-26 launch/failure details (EOS-05, NVS-02, NavIC clocks) and multi-statement items deeper than PYQs.
